title: My Son Forged A Dissolution, Sold My Stained Glass, And Left Me $4,100. So I Voided The Sale
description: My son forged a dissolution, sold my stained-glass collection to a luxury hotel, and mailed me a $4,100 check with the word came on the memo line. I found the original notarized contract hidden inside a hollow brass came in my studio and voided the entire sale. Now he foils glass edges in a vest that says Cracked Trust and every restoration certificate prints his fraud docket number. #StainedGlass #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY STAINED GLASS, NOW HE WEARS CRACKED TRUST
pinned_comment: If your own son mailed you a $4,100 check for your $126,000 stained-glass studio and wrote 'came' on the memo line, would you void the sale and make him wear the Cracked Trust vest, or let him keep everything? Share your story in the comments if you have ever survived a family betrayal like this.
